name: clock-reads
description: CLOCK ratchet. Every direct wall-clock read in server/ (Date.now, new Date() with no argument, Date(), Date['now'], performance.timeOrigin, and aliases of Date.now) outside the one clock, server/utils/clock.ts. Such reads are invisible in production and make simulation impossible: the founder simulation's 30-day run produced 2 articles because the autopilot's exactly-once key bucketed on the wall clock (2026-10-07). Counted by a TypeScript parse (comments and strings never count). Strictly down: convert reads to clock.now()/clock.nowMs() (scripts/codemods/use-the-clock.mjs) and lower baselineCount in the same commit.
lastBumpNote: 2026-10-07 simplat: seeded at 3786 measured; the codemod converted the simulation-exercised paths (autopilot, solene, dunning, trial, churn, campaigns, sequences, jobs, onboarding, pax nudges, founder digest, TCPA/SMS/email/direct-mail send paths, support, founder chat) to 3126.
